items.quote: Item No. 3 of the Notice as a Special Resolution Issue of equity shares on preferential basis to the person / entity belonging to the non-promoter category.

items.statement: Non-convertible debentures issuance up to Rs 100 crore proposed as special resolution
items.quote: Item No. 4 of the Notice as a Special Resolution To consider and approve the issuance of non -convertible debentures amounting to ₹ 1,00,00,00,000 (rupees one hundred crores only) in one or more tranches.

items.statement: Resolutions 2 to 4 require in-principal approval from Stock Exchange which is pending
items.quote: The resolutions as outlined in the EOGM notice as Item Nos. 1 shall be deemed to be passed today, subject to the receipt of the requisite number of votes, but from item no. 2 to 4 will be stand passed only when the in-principal approval of the Stock Exchange is received which is still pending.
